name.en: Federal Highway 2, eastern segment (Ciudad Acuña–Nuevo Laredo–Reynosa–Matamoros, La Ribereña)
name.zh: 2 号联邦公路东段（阿库尼亚城—新拉雷多—雷诺萨—马塔莫罗斯，“河岸公路”）

aka.en: La Ribereña (the riverside road, Nuevo Laredo–Reynosa)

aka.zh: 马塔莫罗斯—新拉雷多边境走廊

tagline.en: The border road along the Río Bravo from the Amistad dam to the Gulf of Mexico, linking every crossing from Ciudad Acuña to Matamoros, and for years a road many people avoided
tagline.zh: 沿布拉沃河从友谊水库通往墨西哥湾的边境公路，串联起从阿库尼亚城到马塔莫罗斯的每一个口岸，多年来也是许多人避而不走的道路

start.en: Ciudad Acuña, Coahuila, at the international crossing on the Amistad dam to Del Rio, Texas
start.zh: 科阿韦拉州阿库尼亚城，友谊水库大坝上通往得克萨斯州德尔里奥的国际口岸

end.en: Playa Lauro Villar (Playa Bagdad), on the Gulf of Mexico east of Matamoros
end.zh: 马塔莫罗斯以东墨西哥湾畔的劳罗比利亚尔海滩（巴格达海滩）

en: The eastern segment of Federal Highway 2 follows the Mexican bank of the Río Bravo, the Rio Grande, from the Amistad dam crossing at Ciudad Acuña through Piedras Negras, where it meets Highway 57, and Nuevo Laredo, where it meets Highway 85, then down the river by Nueva Ciudad Guerrero, Ciudad Mier, Miguel Alemán, Camargo and Gustavo Díaz Ordaz to Reynosa, and on through Río Bravo to Matamoros and the beach at the river mouth. English Wikipedia, from the 2011 road data, gives 644.2 km: 204.02 km in Coahuila, 24 km in Nuevo León and 416.18 km in Tamaulipas.

It is a toll-free road that connects every international crossing on this stretch of the border, and between Reynosa and Matamoros it is paralleled by the toll motorway 2D. The 250 km between Nuevo Laredo and Reynosa are known as La Ribereña. The Tamaulipas Congress said in 2026 that most of this section is still two lanes, and that freight moving along the border uses the roads of Nuevo León instead.
zh: 2 号联邦公路东段沿布拉沃河（格兰德河）墨西哥一侧延伸：自阿库尼亚城的友谊水库口岸起，经彼德拉斯内格拉斯（与 57 号公路交会）和新拉雷多（与 85 号公路交会），再顺河而下经新格雷罗城、米耶尔城、米格尔阿莱曼、卡马戈和古斯塔沃·迪亚斯·奥尔达斯到达雷诺萨，然后经布拉沃河城至马塔莫罗斯和河口海滩。英语维基百科依据 2011 年道路数据给出全长 644.2 公里：科阿韦拉州 204.02 公里，新莱昂州 24 公里，塔毛利帕斯州 416.18 公里。
这是一条免费公路，连接这段边境上的每一个国际口岸；在雷诺萨与马塔莫罗斯之间，另有收费高速 2D 与之并行。新拉雷多至雷诺萨之间的 250 公里被称为“河岸公路”。塔毛利帕斯州议会 2026 年称，这一路段大部分仍为双车道，沿边境运输的货车转而使用新莱昂州的公路。

en: The river towns are older than the road: Ciudad Mier, founded on 6 March 1753 by nineteen families from Camargo and Cerralvo, is one of the oldest settlements on the border. The road ties into the first trunk highway of the national network at Nuevo Laredo, where the México–Nuevo Laredo highway was inaugurated at the international bridge on 1 July 1936. Upstream of Mier, the international Falcón dam flooded the old town of Guerrero, whose people were moved to Nueva Ciudad Guerrero on the present road.

Modernisation has come piece by piece. In 2014 Petróleos Mexicanos, through its Burgos production unit, spent 116 million pesos rebuilding kilometres 104 to 123 between Ciudad Mier and Nueva Ciudad Guerrero, with 3.5 m lanes and 2.5 m shoulders. In 2016 the transport ministry completed 23.2 km of the Matamoros–Nuevo Laredo border corridor from Ciudad Mier to the Nuevo León line, for 285.2 million pesos.

Insecurity has done more than road works to shape the Ribereña. In December 2024 the Tamaulipas security spokesman said that the road had for years been impassable because of it, so that travellers between Reynosa and Nuevo Laredo went by Monterrey or through the United States. The state's answer was a chain of fifteen guarded "safe stations" along the border; in November 2025 the state put the investment at 869 million pesos, with completion planned for 2026. In March 2026 the state Congress asked the federal government to widen the whole Ribereña to four lanes as part of its Corredor del Golfo Norte programme, which as announced did not include it.
zh: 沿河城镇比公路更古老：米耶尔城于 1753 年 3 月 6 日由来自卡马戈和塞拉尔沃的十九户人家建立，是边境上最古老的聚落之一。公路在新拉雷多与全国路网的第一条干线相接，墨西哥城—新拉雷多公路于 1936 年 7 月 1 日在那里的国际桥上举行通车仪式。在米耶尔上游，国际法尔孔水库淹没了格雷罗老城，居民被迁往现今公路边的新格雷罗城。
现代化改造是逐段进行的。2014 年，墨西哥石油公司（Pemex）通过其布尔戈斯生产单位投入 1.16 亿比索，重建了米耶尔城至新格雷罗城之间 104 至 123 公里路段，设 3.5 米车道和 2.5 米路肩。2016 年，交通部完成马塔莫罗斯—新拉雷多边境走廊中米耶尔城至新莱昂州界的 23.2 公里路段，投资 2.852 亿比索。

对“河岸公路”影响最大的不是道路工程，而是治安。2024 年 12 月，塔毛利帕斯州安全发言人称，这条路多年来因治安问题无法通行，往返雷诺萨和新拉雷多的人只能绕道蒙特雷或经由美国。州政府的对策是沿边境修建十五座有警力驻守的“安全站”；2025 年 11 月，州政府公布投资额为 8.69 亿比索，计划 2026 年完工。2026 年 3 月，州议会请求联邦政府在其“北海湾走廊”计划中将整条“河岸公路”拓宽为四车道，因为该计划公布时并未包括这条路。

en: The free road is federal. The parallel toll motorway from Matamoros to Reynosa, 44.04 km, belongs to the FONADIN concession and is maintained under the Paquete Noreste public–private partnership signed on 27 May 2020, which covers 348.63 km of motorways and international bridges in Tamaulipas and Nuevo León for ten years, at 2,468 million pesos paid from tolls.
zh: 免费公路属联邦所有。与之并行的马塔莫罗斯—雷诺萨收费高速长 44.04 公里，属国家基础设施基金（FONADIN）特许范围，由 2020 年 5 月 27 日签署的“东北包”公私合营合同负责维护；该合同涵盖塔毛利帕斯州和新莱昂州共 348.63 公里的高速公路和国际桥梁，期限十年，金额 24.68 亿比索，以通行费偿付。

value.en: 644.2 km for the eastern segment: 204.02 km in Coahuila, 24 km in Nuevo León and 416.18 km in Tamaulipas, from the 2011 Datos Viales, as cited in English Wikipedia
value.zh: 东段 644.2 公里：科阿韦拉州 204.02 公里，新莱昂州 24 公里，塔毛利帕斯州 416.18 公里，出自 2011 年《道路数据》，据英语维基百科引述

figures.source: SCT, Datos Viales 2011 (Coahuila, Nuevo León, Tamaulipas), as cited in English Wikipedia, Mexican Federal Highway 2

why.en: No public figure for the original border road; only the costs of recent sections are published, below.
why.zh: 原有边境公路无公开造价；仅有近年各段的公开造价，见下文。

label.zh: 米耶尔城—新莱昂州界段

value.en: 285.2 million pesos for 23.2 km of the Matamoros–Nuevo Laredo border corridor, completed 2016
value.zh: 马塔莫罗斯—新拉雷多边境走廊 23.2 公里，2.852 亿比索，2016 年完工

figures.source: SCT, Dirección General de Carreteras, memoria documental

label.zh: 2014 年墨西哥石油公司工程

value.zh: 米耶尔城—新格雷罗城 104 至 123 公里，1.16 亿比索

value.en: Federal for the free road, with Pemex funding one section in 2014; the Matamoros–Reynosa toll motorway is paid from tolls under FONADIN.
value.zh: 免费公路由联邦出资，2014 年其中一段由墨西哥石油公司出资；马塔莫罗斯—雷诺萨收费高速在国家基础设施基金下以通行费偿付。

figures.source: SCT, Dirección General de Carreteras, memoria documental; Pemex, 30 December 2014; Proyectos México, 0885 Paquete Noreste

value.zh: 沿边境建十五座州警察站，8.69 亿比索（塔毛利帕斯州政府，2025 年 11 月），计划 2026 年完工

figures.source: Gobierno del Estado de Tamaulipas, 11 November 2025; Nota Tamaulipas, 7 December 2024

timeline.en: Ciudad Mier is founded on 6 March by families from Camargo and Cerralvo.
timeline.zh: 3 月 6 日，来自卡马戈和塞拉尔沃的家庭建立米耶尔城。

timeline.en: The México–Nuevo Laredo highway is inaugurated at the Nuevo Laredo international bridge on 1 July.
timeline.zh: 7 月 1 日，墨西哥城—新拉雷多公路在新拉雷多国际桥举行通车仪式。

timeline.en: Pemex completes the rebuilding of kilometres 104 to 123 near Ciudad Mier.
timeline.zh: 墨西哥石油公司完成米耶尔城附近 104 至 123 公里路段的重建。

timeline.en: The ministry completes 23.2 km from Ciudad Mier to the Nuevo León line.
timeline.zh: 交通部完成米耶尔城至新莱昂州界的 23.2 公里路段。

timeline.en: The Paquete Noreste partnership for the Matamoros–Reynosa toll road and other motorways is signed on 27 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 27 日，涵盖马塔莫罗斯—雷诺萨收费高速等路段的“东北包”公私合营合同签署。

timeline.en: Tamaulipas approves financing for fifteen safe stations to reopen the Ribereña.
timeline.zh: 塔毛利帕斯州批准为十五座安全站融资，以重新打通“河岸公路”。

timeline.en: The state reports 869 million pesos invested in the safe stations.
timeline.zh: 州政府公布安全站投资 8.69 亿比索。

timeline.en: The Tamaulipas Congress asks for the whole Ribereña to be widened to four lanes.
timeline.zh: 塔毛利帕斯州议会请求将整条“河岸公路”拓宽为四车道。
